reviews.text: I arrived a week early for my appointment and was still helped in a friendly manner. Pleasant vet.
Very professional and caring vets. After diagnosing my cat with mouth cancer we were immediately referred to a specialist. They saved us a lot of unnecessary procedures and costs.
Best vets 🤍 they are so friendly and helpful always! They love animals and are very gentle, and they always answer any question you may have with empathy and patience! …

I could get an appointment right away. I didn't have to wait long with Poes either. Very friendly vet, everything was calm, took their time, and the examination was done immediately. They looked for a suitable solution, all in a calm, friendly, and professional atmosphere. Top clinic!
The friendly vet staff really took the time to examine our cat and find a solution to my question. I felt truly supported; I went home relieved and will be back soon with our new kitten.
